system.description:
A character using Form of the Cobra gains a venomous bite along with his serpentine form, but the full-body transformation tends to make onlookers flee. Cobra Fangs lets a Setite gain the deadly bite without the full transformation, making it far more useful for taking a victim by surprise.

You expend one Blood Trait and in one turn your fangs become hollow, slender and venomous. You must still grapple with the victim to deliver a bite attack (a normal Physical Challenge), and the bite does the usual amount of damage, but the venom kills mortals within one minute. Vampires or other supernaturally resilient creatures bitten this way suffer ten health levels of aggravated damage, minus one per dot of Stamina, over the course of five minutes.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
system.duration: Full scene or one hour, whichever is shorter
